rows.grounds: fused form ghoraghoratara+iti+ante; marks the end of the ghoraghoratara element
compound tanu-rūpa-pada; accusative singular neuter noun

items.question: Which pada follows the ghoraghoratara element in the mantra?
premises: ghoraghorataretyante marks the end of the ghoraghoratara element
items.inference: the next pada after ghoraghoratara is tanurūpa
uncertainties: exact internal sandhi of ghoraghorataretyante is editorially fused
tanurūpapadaṃ may be compound or phrase
items.plain_english: Then, after the ghoraghoratara element, comes the tanu-rūpa pada.
